name: The Twins
bio: Archetype: Conduit, Dual Afflatus. ⌽ At the start of the round, if The Twins' Harmonization is full, generates a precast of The Twins' Energy cards. ⌽ Set A Buff card gives Mineral Energy and Harmonization while Set B gives a buff to Crit stats and Harmonization, this buff card can only be cast once per round. ⌽ Set A Attack card costs 3 Mineral Energy and deals more DMG based on Energy consumed by allies that round. Set B Attack card costs 1 Star Energy and deals more DMG based on how many times it was cast that round. ⌽ Ult counts as both Star and Mineral afflatus, consumes all Energy, deals more DMG based on the Energy consumed, increases Crit Rate, Pen Rate gains Crit Convert.
